data.statement: Recent city-specific anomalies of the hottest day persist. The cross-city slope of (next-7-year mean − 30-year mean) on (last-15-year mean − 30-year mean), with the national mean removed, averages 0.42 over 10 origins; for precipitation it is 0.21. The current forecast uses λ = 0 for these metrics (the 30-year mean), and the rejected shorter windows use λ = 1. So m30 + λ̂·(A_city), with λ̂ fitted in-fold on pseudo-origins (about 0.4 for the hottest day), will give positive hottest-day skill.
